posts.post: If you skipped breakfast I know. Come. The gravy is still here and so am I.
New mix on the kiosk speaker. Hate it and I change it after this song. Maybe.
Jollof at Mzansi House. I will be kind about the rice. For ten minutes. Then we talk.
Study group, campus library, six. Late and I start. Bring a charger, not a speech.
Open mic list is full. I wrote your name anyway. Do not make me look foolish.
Headphones on. If you need the charger, ask. If you need a lecture, keep walking.
Biryani is not a suggestion today. Sit first. Then we discuss that test you are avoiding.
Grill is honest. Your match opinions can wait until the roll has landed.
Hello my child. Looking is free. Vetkoek is ten rand. Eating is the wise one.
Wrote a line about the rank and the lights stayed on. Open mic. I will not beg.
The terrace seat is still mine. Bring an argument or bring rooibos. Both preferred.
Laptop has three working keys. The board post has more. Come fix yours, not mine.
Outfit today is a seven. Fixable. Fitting Thursday if you want an eight.
Pap and a gym. That is the whole personality. Third plate is a love language.
Twenty-seven bones in the hand. I counted again. Study angel, I still need you.
Res kettle only sparks a little now. I work for vetkoek. Headphones welcome.
Audition: Romeo in a taxi. Experimental. Front row, clap like you mean the fare.
If your budget has feelings, sit down. I have a spreadsheet and a kind face.
Did you sleep. That was not a question. Study group still has a chair with your name.
Phone on 12%. If you have a charger you are my favourite person until supper.
